purpose: order 4.5.4: one proposed rule to mark roof-like patches where the GT (ULS nadir) may not represent the surface the images see (glass, translucent faces); a flag only (array gt_suspect in the region v2 files), region codes unchanged, removal decided by the user
rule: a roof-like patch with an owned ULS GT point is GT suspect when (a) the GT height range in the 0.25 m cell of its centre minus the range a plane of its prior face's slope makes over the cell diagonal (0.354 m x tan(theta), theta capped at 80 degrees) exceeds 0.3 m (two layers), or (b) at least 5 % of its owned ULS GT points come from pulses with more than one return (the laser went through)
evaluated_patches: roof-like patches of codes 2 and 3 (regions v2), whose owned ULS GT points were matched to the raw laz; other patches are not evaluated (gt_suspect_evaluated False)

choice.criterion: written before choosing: among the candidates whose mean flagged share in the support agreement (code 2) is at most 15 %, the largest mean contrast (flagged share in 3 minus in 2) over the four sites x two priors
choice.note: no candidate separates the two regions well at every site: at B173nb_b10 (LoD2, faces <= 17 degrees) the double layer is 80 % vs 16 %, at B173_b0 and R1rep_b10 there is no contrast; R1rep's observation errors are the translucent roof where the MVS lies 2.6 m above both GT and LoD2 (a premise case, not a GT defect)
